name: Scenario A: Routine Plumbing Repair
description: Happy path — leaking tap, routine severity, accepted first time

reportProblem.description: Kitchen tap is leaking continuously. Water has caused damage to the chipboard cabinet underneath the sink. The cabinet door is swollen and won't close properly.
reportProblem.urgencyDescription: Not an emergency but getting worse — bucket filling up twice a day
reportProblem.accessNotes: Key safe at side gate, code shared with housing office. Available weekdays 9am-5pm.

requirements: Replace tap unit (mixer tap, kitchen spec)
Inspect for further water damage to adjacent units
Replace damaged cabinet panel if beyond repair
triageAllocate.allocationNotes: Standard plumbing job. Tenant has key safe access so no need for appointment.

verifyOperative.verificationNotes: Credential matches — Jamie Crawford, Stoniebridge Construction

completedItems: Replaced tap unit — fitted Bristan Quest mono mixer
Checked isolation valve — functioning correctly, no leak
Inspected adjacent cabinets — no further water damage
Replaced damaged cabinet panel with matching unit
completeWork.materialsUsed: Bristan Quest mono mixer tap, 15mm flexi connectors x2, cabinet panel (600mm white melamine)
completeWork.deliveryNotes: Tap replaced and tested with no leaks. Cabinet panel replaced. All waste removed from property.

reviewCompletion.reviewNotes: All checklist items completed. Photos show clean installation. No further action required.

confirmSatisfaction.feedbackNotes: Very tidy job, thank you. Kitchen is back to normal.
